{
  "version": "1.51.0",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-18",
  "standards": [
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.primary-header",
      "title": "Dialog Primary Header",
      "value": "PrimaryHeader uses DIALOG_PRIMARY_HEADER_CLASS (h-10 fixed); title plus optional headerExtra icon-only controls (AppButton size=icon-sm) before Close; Close is always rightmost via AppButton closeIcon; no labeled buttons in primary header",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialog headers",
        "modal headers",
        "DialogPrimaryHeader"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.footers",
      "title": "Dialog Footers",
      "value": "multiple footers allowed; ActionFooter (DIALOG_ACTION_FOOTER_CLASS) must be last with primary actions (AppButton size=sm, justify-end); AuxiliaryFooter (DIALOG_AUXILIARY_FOOTER_CLASS) for metadata or wizard navigation (justify-between allowed)",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialog footers",
        "modal footers",
        "DialogFooter"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.wizard.footer-navigation",
      "title": "Step Wizard Footer Navigation",
      "value": "footer uses STEP_WIZARD_FOOTER_CLASS with Previous (AppButton intent=cancel, disabled on first step, ChevronLeft), center Step X / Y counter, and Next (AppButton intent=secondary, disabled on last step or when canMoveNext is false, ChevronRight); final-step primary submit action (Create, Save, Apply) renders through footerExtra with intent=primary to the left of the counter; do not replace Next with submit on non-final steps",
      "appliesTo": [
        "step wizards",
        "wizard footers",
        "wizard navigation"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.labeled-icon-required",
      "title": "Labeled Button Icon Required",
      "value": "every labeled/text AppButton with a visible text label must include a leading Lucide icon (h-3.5 w-3.5) before the label — modal footer buttons, form submit/save/cancel rows, toolbar labeled actions, wizard footer actions; pick an icon that matches the action semantics (X cancel, Trash2 delete, Check save/confirm, UploadCloud publish, etc.); exception: icon-only buttons (size icon-sm or icon-md with no visible label) and AppButton closeIcon",
      "appliesTo": [
        "labeled action buttons",
        "modal footer buttons",
        "form action buttons",
        "toolbar labeled buttons",
        "wizard footer buttons"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.semantic-intents",
      "title": "Labeled Button Semantic Color Intents",
      "value": "all labeled/text buttons must use AppButton or buttonSemantics intents: primary/create=solid indigo; cancel=slate outline; destructive=solid rose; destructive-soft=rose outline; confirm=emerald outline; secondary=indigo outline; utility=cyan outline; warning=amber outline; toggle-on=cyan soft; toggle-off=indigo soft; modal close icons use AppButton closeIcon",
      "appliesTo": [
        "toolbar buttons",
        "modal footer buttons",
        "form action buttons",
        "labeled action buttons"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.icon-only.square",
      "title": "Icon-Only Button Square Shape",
      "value": "icon-only buttons (no visible text label) must be square with equal width and height; use AppButton size icon-sm (h-7 w-7) in compact toolbars or icon-md (h-8 w-8) in page/sidebar tool rows; do not use horizontal padding or unequal dimensions that make icon controls rectangular",
      "appliesTo": [
        "icon-only buttons",
        "sidebar tool controls",
        "compact toolbar icon buttons"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.new-plus-icon.secondary",
      "title": "New/Create Icon-Only Plus Button Color",
      "value": "New/Create icon-only Plus buttons must use AppButton with intent secondary (soft indigo outline: border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100); reference DesignerPaletteSidebar.tsx and FunctionListSidebar.tsx; labeled Create buttons with visible text keep intent create (solid indigo)",
      "appliesTo": [
        "new/create icon-only plus buttons",
        "sidebar new actions",
        "palette new actions"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.toolbar.refresh-button",
      "title": "Toolbar Refresh Button",
      "value": "page toolbars that reload list/grid data must use ToolbarRefreshButton (src/shared/ui/ToolbarRefreshButton.tsx) as the rightmost control in PAGE_TOOLBAR_ACTIONS_CLUSTER_CLASS; size icon-md (h-8 w-8), intent utility, RefreshCw h-3.5 w-3.5 with spin when isRefreshing; title and aria-label from culture actions.refresh; separatorBefore true when other actions precede refresh, false when refresh is alone; never ad-hoc RefreshCw/RotateCw AppButton in page toolbars",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page toolbars",
        "grid toolbars",
        "settings list toolbars",
        "CRUD list toolbars"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.toolbar.action-semantics",
      "title": "Toolbar Action Semantic Colors",
      "value": "toolbar buttons with the same role use the same AppButton intent across pages: create/add/new labeled=create; refresh/reload=ToolbarRefreshButton utility; test/connectivity/expand-collapse=utility; sync/positive reconcile=confirm; push/pull/secondary remote=secondary; clear/flush/bulk delete=destructive-soft; commit/primary workflow=primary; see docs/standards/ui-toolbar.md action table",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page toolbars",
        "grid toolbars",
        "settings toolbars",
        "labeled toolbar buttons"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.destructive.confirmation.body",
      "title": "Destructive Confirmation Body Layout",
      "value": "destructive confirmation dialog body is flat white typography only — no nested rounded-md border bg-* panel boxes around the message; use size/weight hierarchy (semibold question, xs muted warning, optional font-mono entity name/path); English copy in RTL locales uses dir=ltr and text-start on the body block; destructive footer uses Cancel plus destructive AppButton with Trash2 icon; reference ServerFunctionDeleteModal.tsx and docs/standards/confirmations.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "delete confirmation modals",
        "ConfirmDialogShell body content",
        "destructive confirmation modals"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "api.server-functions.openapi-docs",
      "title": "Server Functions OpenAPI Documentation",
      "value": "every managed and built-in server function route must expose OpenAPI 3.1.2 and server-served Swagger UI (swagger-ui-dist >= 5.32.x) via reserved /api/docs paths — aggregated spec/UI require auth and include only routes visible to the caller (canAccessFunctionDoc in buildManagedFunctionOpenApi.ts; ADMIN bypass; built-in access_control + metadata allowedRoles); scoped /api/docs/routes/:functionId uses the same access gate; canonical generator buildManagedFunctionOpenApi.ts with script parser parseServerFunctionScriptDoc.ts (primary: code script VALIDATION_SCHEMA/SQL/comments/req usage; fallback metadata_json + autoCrudRequestGuide or apiDoc + test_payload); include built-in routes via serverFunctionDocCatalog.ts; cache full aggregated spec by content fingerprint in openApiSpec.service.ts, filter per principal on read, invalidate on managed-function CRUD; document { success: true, data, count?, source? } and { success: false, error } with bearerAuth JWT; UI opens /api/docs and /api/docs/routes/:functionId in new tabs via AppButton intent=utility (built-in enabled); never embed Swagger in React admin or place docs under business resource paths; greenfield only (no Swagger 2.0 or dual-format legacy)",
      "appliesTo": [
        "buildManagedFunctionOpenApi",
        "docs.routes",
        "openApiSpec.service",
        "FunctionListSidebar",
        "ServerFunctionEditorPanel",
        "managedFunctionRouteRegistry"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "matchCount": 11,
  "truncated": false,
  "maxRules": 20,
  "knowledgeKinds": [
    "STANDARD",
    "ANTI_PATTERN"
  ],
  "agentsMdPointer": "See AGENTS.md hub and docs/standards/INDEX.md for topic shards.",
  "runtimeApi": "/api/project-standards",
  "shardHint": "Pass shard (e.g. ui-grid) to load the full markdown topic file."
}
